card.fact_statement: Hurricane Erick became the earliest major hurricane on record to make landfall on either coast of Mexico.
card.answer: earliest major hurricane on record to make landfall
card.source_span: Erick also became the earliest major hurricane on record to make landfall on either coast of Mexico
aliases: earliest major hurricane to make landfall
